visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a black sparkly sweater and a silver necklace, speaks to the camera inside a car. Her facial expressions are joyful as she points to her cheek. (2) The camera pans to show a man in the driver's seat wearing a denim jacket and sunglasses; he smiles briefly. (3) The woman laughs, covering her mouth with her hand, and then holds up a white document folder with the text "戶口名簿" visible. (4) The scene shifts to the woman walking down a bright, sterile office hallway with blue floor markings, holding papers and a smartphone. (5) The couple is seen from behind sitting at a registration desk, separated from a masked clerk by a clear partition. (6) A close-up shot shows their marriage application document, featuring their photos and signatures, as hands point to specific sections. (7) A series of clips show four different female friends sitting in the waiting area, each speaking to the camera with high energy and gesturing with their hands. (8) The video concludes with the couple standing in front of a pink floral backdrop that says "Xin Yi Taipei," where they pose, look at each other, and kiss.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a couple's major life milestone of getting legally married. It serves as a personal vlog to share the joy of the day, provide a brief 'how-to' regarding required documents, and capture the celebratory blessings from their social circle.
